# Generated by tools/r5_visible_unions.py --write.
smallpox = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = { value = 0.010 }
	spawn = {
		random_ownable_location = {
			limit = { is_land = yes population > 1 }
			spawn_disease = { disease = scope:disease value = 0.35 save_scope_as = outbreak }
		}
	}
	r0 = { value = { 2.5 5 } }
	calc_interval_days = { 5 12 }
	# An outbreak may travel through a regional road/port corridor, but its
	# original focus remains the distance anchor.  A flat stagnation chance let
	# lightly infected edges relay smallpox and measles around the whole world
	# in two to four years during the AD 1 production run.
	location_stagnation_chance = {
		if = {
			limit = { "disease_presence(scope:disease)" > 0.05 }
			value = "distance_to_squared(scope:disease.origin)"
			multiply = 0.0006
			multiply = 0.005
		}
		else = {
			value = "distance_to_squared(scope:disease.origin)"
			multiply = 0.00006
		}
		add = 0.2
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement
					AND = {
						num_roads = 0
						OR = {
							topography = mountains
							topography = wetlands
							vegetation = desert
							vegetation = jungle
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 0.15
		}
	}
	# Armies can carry sickness, but an isolated marching unit must not bypass
	# the geographic bound and create a second intercontinental focus.
	sub_unit_stagnation_chance = { value = 0.65 }
	percentage_to_meet_their_fate_on_calc = { value = 0.3 }
	location_spread_threshold = { value = 0.12 }
	monthly_resistance_reduction = 0.001
	mortality_rate = { value = { 0.08 0.28 } }
	character_mortality_chance = { value = 0.08 multiply = "disease_presence(scope:disease)" }
	location_modifier = {
		local_population_growth = -0.04
		local_forced_attrition = 2
		local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = -0.2
		local_prosperity_decay = 0.01
		local_migration_attraction = -0.5
	}
	on_spread_to_country = {
		if = { limit = { always = no } trigger_event_non_silently = diseases.1 }
	}
	map_color = { lerp = { min_color = rgb { 170 160 140 } max_color = rgb { 92 142 82 } factor = "disease_presence(scope:disease)" } }
	secondary_map_color = { if = { limit = { disease_affects_pops_here = scope:disease } value = rgb { 92 142 82 } } }
}
